Remark
[Lie derivative of a vector field via the Levi-Civita connection] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0295 1. Equation A.1\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The Lie derivative of a vector field may be computed from the Levi-Civita connection by \[ \Lie _XY=[X,Y]= abla _XY- abla _YX. \]
